name: [Platform] 08 GitOps Prompt Management

parameters.content:
## Reusable platform service: GitOps Prompt Registry

**Input** `prompt_id` (e.g. `research/planner`), `variables` (JSON string), `ref` (branch, tag or commit SHA — defaults to `main`), `owner`, `repo`, `strict`, `source_workflow`.

**Output** `{ ok, degraded, prompt, sha, version, ref, declared_variables[], missing_variables[], issues[], provenance }`

Changing a prompt is a commit. No workflow JSON is edited and no n8n node is touched. Rolling back is passing an older `ref`.

## Reliability and traceability

The fetch retries 3x with a 1.5s backoff and uses `neverError` so a 404 or a 403 rate limit is handled as data, not as a crash.

On failure the service serves a **bundled fallback** copy for the hot-path prompts and sets `degraded: true` plus an explicit issue, so a caller can never silently run on stale text believing it came from Git.

Every successful render returns the GitHub **blob SHA**, so an execution log can be tied back to the exact prompt bytes that produced it.

nodes.name: Slim Prompt Result
nodes.notes: Drops the rendered prompt body before looping back. Keeps the loop context small so execution payloads stay readable.

description: Reusable prompt registry. Fetches versioned prompts from GitHub at run time, validates declared variables, interpolates, and returns the blob SHA so every model call is traceable to an exact prompt version.
